pass_rule: PASS is derived iff expected_count equals executed_count; missing_count, extra_count, duplicate_count, and mismatch_count are zero; every registered negative mutation returns its exact expected failure; evidence-role cardinality is exact; and every required independent implementation returns byte-identical canonical output or the same typed failure code.
fixture_rule: Every test binds generator name/version/source hash, coverage axes, a materialized ordered case list, expected canonical output or typed failure per case, negative mutations, prerequisite roles, expected count, reducer hash, and a completeness proof when the cases are generated rather than directly enumerated.
independence_rule: Where cardinality is two, implementation IDs, executable hashes, and root algorithm source hashes differ. Shared schema/canonicalization dependencies are disclosed. This is process evidence, not a statistical independence claim.
phase_rule: T01 is a pre-ratification specification check executed only by the already-authorized generic intake validator. T02-T12 plus PPC-specific schema/fixture conformance are post-ratification and PRE_MODEL. T13 is the final PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION authority gate. No model, tokenizer, embedding, trainer, canary, CPU behavioral, GPU behavioral, or GPU job is reachable before T01-T13 and separate run ratification pass.
